subject: pharmacology
title: Drugs for bronchial asthma, COPD and cough

steps.tx: **Asthma pharmacotherapy** separates relievers that open airways within minutes from controllers that suppress underlying airway inflammation over weeks of regular use. **Inhaled corticosteroids** form the controller foundation at every persistent step because they reduce exacerbations and asthma deaths. Short acting beta agonists rescue bronchospasm on demand, and modern inhalers increasingly pair the reliever with inhaled steroid so rescue treatment also delivers anti inflammatory therapy.
steps.say: Relievers open narrowed airways quickly while controllers suppress inflammation slowly over weeks. Inhaled corticosteroids form the foundation because they prevent attacks and reduce deaths. Rescue inhalers increasingly provide a bronchodilator with a steroid and help treat risk in one device. This pairing treats risk at the exact moment symptoms appear.

vis.alt: Diagram showing asthma drugs split into Relievers (SABA for bronchodilation) and Controllers (ICS for anti-inflammation), with ICS as foundational.
vis.caption: Asthma drugs: relievers for acute symptoms, controllers for inflammation

steps.tx: **Beta two agonists** relax bronchial smooth muscle through cyclic AMP and provide the main rescue and maintenance bronchodilation in asthma. Salbutamol rescues symptoms for a few hours, while **salmeterol and formoterol** maintain dilation for twelve hours and must never run without inhaled steroid cover. Formoterol acts rapidly enough for reliever pairing strategies, and tremor, tachycardia and **hypokalaemia** reveal systemic spillover during heavy use.
steps.say: Beta two agonists help relax airway smooth muscle and reduce bronchospasm within minutes of inhalation. Salbutamol rescues acute symptoms while long acting agents maintain control for twelve hours. Long acting bronchodilators must never run alone without inhaled steroid cover. Tremor and low potassium reveal systemic absorption during repeated nebulised treatment.

rows: Add on, exercise and aspirin sensitive

steps.tx: **Inhaled corticosteroids** reduce exacerbations, hospital admissions and asthma deaths when patients use them regularly with correct technique. Local adverse effects include oral candidiasis and hoarseness, and spacers with mouth rinsing prevent most problems effectively. **Montelukast** helps exercise induced and aspirin sensitive asthma as an oral night dose, while **theophylline** remains a specialist option because its narrow window causes interactions and arrhythmias.
steps.say: Inhaled corticosteroids prevent exacerbations and save lives when patients use them daily. Spacers and mouth rinsing prevent oral thrush and hoarseness during long term therapy. Montelukast helps patients whose symptoms follow exercise or aspirin exposure. Theophylline requires blood monitoring because interactions and arrhythmias limit its safety.

steps.tx: Severe asthma needs phenotype directed **biologic therapy** after inhaler technique, adherence and triggers have been corrected carefully. **Omalizumab** traps IgE in allergic disease, anti interleukin five agents deplete eosinophils, and dupilumab blocks interleukin four and thirteen signalling in type two inflammation. In acute severe attacks, systemic steroids, nebulised bronchodilators, ipratropium and intravenous **magnesium** form the escalating treatment ladder.
steps.say: Severe asthma requires biologic therapy that matches the dominant inflammatory pathway precisely. Omalizumab helps trap IgE in allergic disease while anti interleukin five drugs reduce eosinophils markedly. Dupilumab blocks interleukin four and thirteen signalling in type two inflammation. Acute severe attacks require systemic steroids and nebulised bronchodilators without delay.

steps.tx: The airway cross section shows a thickened bronchiole wall packed with eosinophils and a green **mucus plug** narrowing the lumen almost completely. Antibodies around the wall show three targets, with omalizumab trapping **IgE**, anti interleukin five drugs removing eosinophils and dupilumab blocking **interleukin four and thirteen** signalling. The picture explains why biomarker matched biologics help severe asthma that inhalers cannot control.
steps.say: The image shows a narrowed bronchiole filled with mucus and surrounded by eosinophils. Omalizumab traps IgE while anti interleukin five drugs remove eosinophils from tissue. Dupilumab blocks interleukin four and thirteen signalling in the airway wall. Matching the antibody to biomarkers improves control in severe disease.

steps.tx: **COPD therapy** emphasises long acting bronchodilation with LAMA and LABA combinations rather than early inhaled steroids for most patients. Clinicians reserve **inhaled corticosteroids** for frequent exacerbators with raised eosinophils because steroids increase pneumonia risk in this population. Antitussives suppress cough weakly, mucolytics help selected chronic bronchitis modestly, and suppressing a productive cough in **bronchiectasis** harms secretion clearance more than it comforts.
steps.say: COPD treatment prioritises long acting bronchodilators over inhaled steroids for most patients. Steroids help only selected frequent exacerbators and increase pneumonia risk substantially. Cough suppressants provide weak benefit and delay secretion clearance in bronchiectasis. Mucolytics reduce exacerbations modestly in carefully selected chronic bronchitis patients.
